{{Top|leg}}
'''Grig Starport''', also known as '''Narg Starport''' was a public starport located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Grig]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Narg]]. It was situated on [[Starport Street]], and included the [[Narg Cultural Information Center]], [[Narg Starport Souvenir Shop]], and [[Landing Bay 17]].<ref name="Abduction">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref>
